WITH latest AS (
  SELECT run_id
  FROM ops.pipeline_metric
  WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%'
  GROUP BY run_id
  ORDER BY max(metric_ts) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(max(metric_value), 0) AS value FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) AND metric_name IN ('gate_status_pass','gate_status_warning','gate_status_block');

WITH latest AS (

  LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(max(metric_value), 0) AS value FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) AND metric_name = 'consumer_lag_after';

  LIMIT 1

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT run_id
  FROM ops.pipeline_metric
  WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%'
  GROUP BY run_id
  ORDER BY max(metric_ts) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(max(metric_value), 0) AS value FROM ops.pipeline_metric WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) AND metric_name = 'consumer_retry';

SELECT
  run_id,
  max(metric_ts) AS last_metric_ts,
  max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'producer_emitted' THEN metric_value END)::bigint AS producer_emitted,
  max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'producer_accepted' THEN metric_value END)::bigint AS producer_accepted,
  max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'consumer_processed' THEN metric_value END)::bigint AS consumer_processed,
  max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'consumer_inserted' THEN metric_value END)::bigint AS consumer_inserted,
  max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'consumer_committed' THEN metric_value END)::bigint AS consumer_committed,
  max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'consumer_retry' THEN metric_value END)::bigint AS retry,
  max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'consumer_dlq' THEN metric_value END)::bigint AS dlq,
  max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'consumer_lag_after' THEN metric_value END)::bigint AS lag_after,
  CASE
    WHEN max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'gate_status_block' THEN metric_value END) = 1 THEN 'BLOCK'
    WHEN max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'gate_status_warning' THEN metric_value END) = 1 THEN 'WARN'
    WHEN coalesce(max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'consumer_lag_after' THEN metric_value END), 0) = 0
      AND coalesce(max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'consumer_dlq' THEN metric_value END), 0) = 0
      AND coalesce(max(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'consumer_retry' THEN metric_value END), 0) = 0
    THEN 'PASS'
    ELSE 'CHECK'
  END AS gate_status
FROM ops.pipeline_metric
WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%'
  AND metric_ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY run_id
ORDER BY last_metric_ts DESC;

SELECT metric_ts AS time, metric_value AS value, run_id || ' / ' || metric_name AS metric
FROM ops.pipeline_metric
WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%'
  AND metric_name IN ('producer_accepted','consumer_processed','consumer_inserted','consumer_committed')
  AND metric_ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY metric_ts;

SELECT metric_ts AS time, metric_value AS value, run_id || ' / ' || metric_name AS metric
FROM ops.pipeline_metric
WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%'
  AND metric_name IN ('consumer_retry','consumer_dlq','consumer_lag_after','missing_from_db')
  AND metric_ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY metric_ts;

SELECT metric_ts, run_id, stage, metric_name, metric_value, unit, labels
FROM ops.pipeline_metric
WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%'
  AND metric_ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY metric_ts DESC, run_id, metric_name
LIMIT 300;

SELECT metric_ts AS time, metric_value AS value, run_id || ' / ' || metric_name AS metric
FROM ops.pipeline_metric
WHERE stage LIKE 'live_soak_%'
  AND metric_name IN ('consumer_duplicate','consumer_reprocessed')
  AND metric_ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY metric_ts;
